title: Three-column social feed dashboard with one interactive blue (CozMeet)
attribution_visible_in_image: Brand name 'CozMeet' in the mockup; no creator credit visible.
contains_third_party_content: Profile photos, a street-art mural photograph, 'Dribbble Pro' and 'Behance Creative' shortcut logos.

observed.layout: Grey page with a white app frame. Top bar: 'CozMeet' logo, pill search, five nav icons with 'Home' active (blue tint and label), user name and a blue 'Switch' link. Left: profile card (cover photo, avatar with yellow ring, name, handle, stats 250 Post / 2022 Followers / 590 Following, blue 'My Profile' button) and a 'Your shortcuts' list. Center: composer ('Share something...' with emoji, Image / Video / Poll, a 'Public' selector, 'Sort by: Recent') and a post card (user, time, blue hashtags, large mural photo, like 320k, comment 120, bookmark 148, share icon, comment field); the next post peeks in. Right: 'Activity' (a Follow link) and 'Suggested For you' with 'Followed' (grey) vs 'Follow' (blue) text actions.
observed.hierarchy: The post image is the largest element; blue marks what is clickable.
observed.typography: Rounded geometric sans, small metadata in grey. Typeface unconfirmed.
observed.iconography: Outline nav icons; icon-only nav beyond the active Home.
observed.materials: White cards with soft radii on grey.

implementation_notes: Three-column CSS grid with sticky side columns.
Follow/Followed state shown by text color, not by a button shape.

concept_work.essence: A well-known three-column shell where blue is the only interactive color.
what_makes_it_work: The post image gives the feed a focal point.
Follow and Followed states are distinguishable.
gaps_to_make_it_work: The active 'Home' label measures about 2.18-2.41:1 and the activity 'Follow' link about 2.38-2.64:1.
The hashtag '#photopgraphy' is misspelled as shown.
'Switch' is ambiguous (account or mode?); nav icons beyond Home are icon-only.

links: Stat counts in the profile card relate to the Follow actions on the right.
The composer feeds the post list.
Blue means interactive or current throughout.

pattern.name: Three-column social shell
avoid_when: The feed is not the main task (use a single column)
adaptation_examples: Photo community: larger media, same shell.
failure_modes: Light interactive blue on white under 3:1

lessons: A light interactive blue on white often falls below 3:1; check the accent itself.
Proofread visible user content in mockups.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
measured.color_roles: White cards on grey; photos supply color; one blue marks the actionable and the current item.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: A familiar social feed whose parts are clearly purposed.
Clear card hierarchy; the photo anchors the page.
Three-column shell conventions are followed; a hashtag typo and inconsistent capitalization are minor.
Active nav, Follow/Followed, composer and sort are shown; error and empty states are not.
Cards, radii and spacing are consistent.
Scored on conservative values: primary text min 2.18:1; secondary text min 2.0:1; icon min n/a:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

critical_failures.description: A primary text/label measures below 3:1 contrast (best estimate)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
